title: #5810's queue-steward Routine prompt cites SKILL sections that no longer exist — its whole case-law pointer set dangles after the principles-only rewrite
body:
Found while executing #7276 (revising clause 6 of the same prompt block). Filed separately and left unassigned: #7276's dispatch scoped the edit to clause 6 only and required the rest of the body be preserved verbatim, so this was deliberately not fixed in that pass.

## Measured (`origin/main` @ `ba2e3c172`, 2026-08-16)

#5810's copy-block prompt opens by telling the seat where its case law lives:

> 先读 /home/user/objectstack/.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md 的「Operational notes」1/2/5/7 与「入队与落地」A/B 段——那是本座位的全部判例法。

**None of those addresses resolve any more.** `ab19075e8` (the principles-only SKILL rewrite) took `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md` from **2568 lines to 686** and re-shaped it around `references/*.md`:

| pointer in the live prompt | where it appears | state on `origin/main` |
|---|---|---|
| 「Operational notes」1/2/5/7 | preamble; 关联 段 | **section deleted** — 5 hits before `ab19075e8`, **0 now** |
| 「入队与落地」A/B 段 | preamble; 关联 段 | section survives as a bold paragraph label under `### 复核`, but **has no A/B segmentation** — it is now three principle bullets |
| `note 7`（完整日志归档） | clause 2 | numbering gone; the rule survives in `references/platform-readings.md` 「读数陷阱」 |
| `note 5`（基缺已合修复） | clause 3 | numbering gone; rule survives in `references/platform-readings.md` |
| `note 3`（GraphQL 配额纪律） | 硬约束 | numbering gone |
| 追记纪律见 SKILL Operational note 2 | 签名台账 section header | numbering gone |

Zero-hit validated against adjacent positives per the SKILL's own rule: `grep` over the same tree finds `bump`, `objectui-sha`, `队列管家职责` — the file is readable and the hits are real, so the `Operational notes` zero is a real absence, not a broken search.

## Why it matters

The prompt does not merely *reference* the SKILL, it declares those sections to be 「本座位的**全部**判例法」. Every fire of the queue-steward Routine opens by trying to read a section set that no longer exists, so the seat either reads nothing and proceeds on improvisation, or spends its opening tokens hunting for the moved content. The four-branch signature triage, the full-log-archive rule and the GraphQL quota discipline are exactly the rules whose absence is silent — the seat still produces a plausible-looking 巡检简报 either way.

This also quietly weakens #6162's fallback: that ruling accepted a degraded mode in which the mechanical-output duty 「靠 prompt 的『每次 fire 读 SKILL』泛化指令弱激活」. That fallback assumes the generic instruction lands somewhere. It currently does not.

## Remedy (same shape as #7276 — issue-body edit + maintainer UI re-copy)

Re-point the prompt at today's structure: `## 队列管家职责` for the seat's own duties, `references/platform-readings.md` for the reading-discipline rules, `references/landing-operations.md` for landing detail — and prefer **naming the rule** over pinning a section name or a note number, since this pointer set has now drifted twice. Then the maintainer re-copies the block into the Routines UI, the same follow-through #6162 and #7276 already owe.

⚠️ Whoever takes this: #5810's body is a live 104-comment anchor and GitHub has no partial-body edit. Follow the procedure that worked on #7276 — decode entities from the read before writing back (`references/platform-readings.md` 「MCP `issue_read` 的 body 实体转义是纯读侧渲染伪影」), replace only the anchored region by script, then re-read and diff. Also note the measured side effect recorded in #5810 comment `5307346655`: a body ending in the **bare** `claude.ai/code` attribution loses that whole footer on any write, silently.

Refs: #5810 (the anchor) · #7276 (the clause-6 half, executed) · #6162 (the ruling whose fallback this weakens) · `ab19075e8` (the rewrite that moved the targets).

No `domain:*` label applied — routing is the triage seat's single-producer territory. Unassigned.
